name: Erasmus University Rotterdam
about: A research university built out of a business school, in a city rebuilt after 1940. Its two large English-taught bachelor programmes — International Business Administration at Rotterdam School of Management and the International Bachelor Economics and Business Economics at Erasmus School of Economics — are both numerus fixus and between them take well over a thousand students a year.

languageOfInstruction.note: Erasmus runs a small number of very large English-taught bachelor programmes rather than a broad English offer. The two recorded here are the largest.

notes: The IBIS institute code 034892 is RSM's, published on RSM's own admission page for graduated applicants who want their IB results verified electronically. It is recorded at institution level because that is where the model holds codes, but it was published by the school rather than by the university.

As of 23 September 2026, both Erasmus pages describe the 2026-2027 round. RSM says its September 2027 requirements will be finalised by 1 October 2026; Erasmus School of Economics says no rights can be derived for following academic years. So check both again in autumn 2026; no 2027 figure is given here that the source did not state.
